lines.quote: Designed and implemented the embedded DSP firmware in C++ for Tuulikallio's acoustic emission monitoring module, running on an ARM Cortex-M7 with a 20 kHz sampling rate.

Own and maintain the production Python data pipeline that processes field data uploaded from deployed monitoring units. The pipeline runs nightly, ingests approximately 2 GB of raw sensor data per run, performs automated anomaly flagging, and writes results to the customer-facing dashboard database.

The front-end analogue chain -- preamplifier and band-pass filter stage -- was characterised on a Rohde & Schwarz ZNB network analyser, running gain, phase, and impedance sweeps across the full operating bandwidth.
MSc Electrical Engineering (Rheinmark TU Aachen, 2015) with a specialisation in digital signal processing and estimation theory.

implemented EKF and UKF variants for sensor-fusion applications in two production sensor products at Tuulikallio, fusing accelerometer, temperature, and acoustic emission data into a composite asset-health indicator.
I have led a three-person firmware subteam at Tuulikallio since 2022, handling sprint planning, task allocation, and code review for the embedded side of our monitoring platform.
Finnish citizen, permanent EU work authorisation.
our weekly engineering reviews, specifications, and design documents are all written and conducted in English.
I am already in Oulu and available for an in-person conversation.

ask_in_screening.question: Can you describe any experience you have designing or implementing phased-array or beamforming signal-processing algorithms?
